scope: Read-only C16k route energy-input and legality audit; no training, inference rollout, oracle or new evaluation.

feature_contract.cpu_energy_proxy: kappa * published_max_frequency**2 * current_task_cycles; full-frequency per-current-task proxy only, no queued or future CPU jobs energy reserved.
feature_contract.cpu_valid: Destination public state valid and published hardware maximum frequency positive; does not mean sufficient energy.
feature_contract.service_valid: Task present, CPU proxy defined, remote rate estimate positive; does not certify energy or future scheduling feasibility.
feature_contract.production_wiring: Physical projection35->32->204 added before existing fusion LayerNorm and shared scorer; unified route consumes raw actor-visible public features.
feature_contract.legality: Remote route legality follows current geometric candidate_neighbors while a task is routable. Public validity, negative energy margin, neighbor energy and age do not add masks. Existing C design explicitly preserves A/B environment legality.

publication_contract.initial_state: All public messages unavailable at reset.
publication_contract.refresh_trigger: A node refreshes only when it is the receiver of an actually attempted accepted positive-power RU/data link, as identified by receiver interference measurement mask.
publication_contract.record_time: Post-service and post-settlement residual energy and aggregate CPU load from completed slot t.
publication_contract.no_refresh: Previous public payload and source timestamp persist; AoI grows. CPU energy consumption by itself does not refresh the public message.
publication_contract.visibility: Candidate-neighbor mask AND public valid mask; selected remote was legal and its receiver history existed for all32 cases.
publication_contract.age_vs_energy: An old message can still have the correct energy scalar if no energy has changed since publication. This does not establish that its queue/position fields remain current.

evidence_limits: Original route logs preserve actions, logits, masks and task IDs but no full actor input tensors or GRU hidden states.
Publication timestamps and partial energy/age/CPU scalar inputs are deterministic reconstructions from recorded TX and CPU traces plus verified unchanged source; not directly logged input snapshots.
The extractor checks use zero placeholders for unrelated fields. They verify the scalar equations and mask independence, not a reconstruction of all35 actual features or a policy forward.
A negative full-frequency task-energy proxy does not prove impossibility at lower frequency. The minimum-frequency bound is reported separately.
These observations do not establish why learned weights prefer the destination or whether continued training will resolve it.
next_step_plan: Use existing C12k and C16k service/route traces under the same five scenes to compare low-energy destination selections, time without any positive energy-feasible CPU head, and affected task completions. This closes the bounded diagnosis and informs the next training-budget decision without changing reward, masks or training settings.
